original_test_intent: Read and preserve AMDGPU RAS error counts for UMC, SDMA, GFX, MMHUB and XGMI_WAFL on the exact approved device/link identities without changing RAS state.
original_method: Verify tool/driver capabilities and GPU/XGMI topology, export baseline logs, issue each block query with its source-specific selector, capture full independent status/output/timestamp and present the resulting counts plus context to the owner without inferring error origin or pass/fail.
manual_activity: The owner supplies device/XGMI mappings and supported blocks and interprets whether recorded counts are expected, historical or newly concerning; no automated hardware verdict is made.
required_inputs: SUT/GPU serials, device indices, firmware/driver/RAS state and amdgpuras version
Supported block IDs/query modes for the installed generation
XGMI_WAFL link names/indices and exact -s syntax/coverage
Expected baseline or interpretation policy for each counter, including unsupported/unknown values
Secure SSH/sudo method and preserved RAS/host/BMC log baseline
safety_requirements: Keep every operation query-only; no error injection, EEPROM/log clear, reset or counter acknowledgment
Preserve logs and pre-existing counters; do not clear to manufacture a zero baseline
Use protected host-key-validated access and least privilege; no sshpass/plaintext secrets
Validate device serial and XGMI links before each query and stop on unsupported options or GPU/driver instability
Do not combine queries so a final exit hides an earlier failure or substitute -d for source -s
agent_execution_scope: Discover/verify tool capability, exact device/link identities and collect baseline health/logs
Run UMC/SDMA/GFX/MMHUB queries separately with approved device selector
Run XGMI_WAFL query separately with approved source link selector
Capture/normalize per-query status/output/count without interpreting fault origin
Package evidence for owner verdict and perform no RAS mutation
engineer_actions: Supply/approve device and XGMI mappings, tool support and expected count semantics
Review nonzero/zero/unsupported outputs in log and workload context
Issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED if the project requires a verdict despite source N/A

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Blocks 0/1/2/3 with device ID are conceptually correct, but a single loop incorrectly applies -d to block 7, whereas Master uses -s xgmi_links. Insecure SSH and 'after injection' language also exceed this row.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run five independent secure structured queries, preserving the device selector for blocks 0-3 and the approved XGMI link selector for block 7, with full output/status per invocation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Block IDs 0,1,2,3,7, query=1, device/link placeholders and 10/10-minute estimates remain exactly scoped.

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH PACKAGE-GATED READ-ONLY AMDGPU RAS COUNTER INVENTORY
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a capability/identity manifest, execute each supported query independently and store counts with block, selector, GPU/link serial, tool version and timestamp plus a preserved-log correlation envelope.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds secure identity, distinct selector semantics and failure isolation while removing log clearing and inferred injection.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A loop output without per-command status can silently miss a block, and using device selector for XGMI cannot prove the requested link counts. Counts alone also do not establish when or why errors occurred.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Counter availability/names and persistence vary by driver/firmware. Zero does not prove absence of all hardware errors; nonzero may predate this observation.

project_override_considerations: If the installed amdgpuras version uses a different XGMI selector, the vendor-approved mapping must be recorded while preserving block-7 link-specific coverage; it cannot be collapsed into a device-only query silently.
expected_evidence: Exact source row/variant/hash and SUT/GPU/firmware/driver/tool identity/capability map
Five separate exact command/status/stdout/stderr/timestamps and parsed counts
Preserved pre/post RAS/GPU/host/BMC logs and query-only/no-clear audit
Owner interpretation of each count/unsupported result and PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED or N/A disposition

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master Procedure consistently defines read-only per-block queries and Criteria intentionally limits scope to recording counts. DeepSeek's selector/injection errors are prior-review defects, not conflicting Master requirements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Tool/mapping and owner count semantics gate execution/verdict but do not prevent complete static review.

review_improvement: Preserves distinct device-versus-link selectors, isolates every query result and prevents counts from being misrepresented as injected or verdict-bearing evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: RAS counters are cumulative observations whose meaning depends on scope and lifetime. Each query must be bound to the physical GPU or XGMI link and tool version; otherwise identical block numbers can refer to different instances. Block 7 is topological rather than merely per-device in the Master, so substituting -d changes coverage. Since no injection or threshold is defined and Criteria is N/A, the engineering result is the traceable counter snapshot—not an inferred DUT PASS or FAIL.
